title: [throwaway probe A — fenced] closing-keyword reading for #8476 step 1
body:
Throwaway target for the #8476 step-1 live reading. This issue is the **FENCED-BLOCK** arm: a throwaway PR will carry a closing keyword bound to this number inside a fenced code block. If a closing link appears here, `stripMarkdownCode`'s fence rule in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` is a false negative and must be revised.

Closed immediately after the reading. No work is requested here.
